name: Craftsman S185
blurb: 18″ homeowner saw: 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links, per Oregon’s model fit guide.
intro: The Craftsman S185 is a gas homeowner saw, and Oregon's model fit guide names it against the 18″ S62 chain: 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links. Craftsman never published its own per-bar chain table for this saw in a source we could read, so this page rests on the chain-maker's fitment data alone — it's accurate for a saw still wearing its original bar, but old Craftsman saws change hands a lot, so check the stamp.

bars.note: Oregon lists the Craftsman S185 in the model fit guide for its S62 chain. Single chain-maker source — confirm on the bar stamp.

sources.title: Product data and model fit guide for Oregon S62 AdvanceCut chain (3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links, 18″ bar)
